opening.argument: The earnings pitch ties Tron returns to paid participation: registration requires TRX-funded slots, while the speaker says, "100 percent of the income goes directly and transparently to the members of the platform with zero risk." The payment flow depends on recruitment and tiered placement, with contributing partners placed beneath participants and payments routed through uplines. It also promotes repeated and increasingly expensive slots, claiming that "the total yield is 11120 percent from one circle of the matrix." These features support a recruitment-commission interpretation, although income is expressly not guaranteed and the records do not verify actual payments or returns.

citations.quote: When you register with Forsage, the first slot of X3 and X4 programs costs 100 TRX each and X Gold 200 TRX
The first contributing partner takes a place under you, 100% payout goes to your personal wallet
100 percent of the income goes directly and transparently to the members of the platform with zero risk
thus the total yield is 11120 percent from one circle of the matrix
